entry_conditions: Drawer_position is strictly above 0.26 m and red is exposed. At the represented action-230 entry, fingers can still be closed and TCP can remain at the drawer front; call drawer_clear. For later entries, call only the phase matching observed geometry: red_acquire near red approach/contact/lift, red_place_release for held-red transport through release and initial clear, bridge_to_blue after red is released and TCP is vertically clear, or blue_acquire when transit/approach to blue is intended.
exit_conditions: Nominal switch cues are red fully contained on the outside pad at z about 0.020 m and no longer following TCP, drawer_position still strictly above 0.26 m, and blue/TCP co-motion after a closed-finger pickup and initial lift. These cues do not add release, clearance or sustained-time requirements to the fixed evaluator.
overlap_role: All assigned actions are supervised exactly once. [230,470) remains 240 actions per demonstration shared with open_drawer and includes world-frame drawer clearance plus red-centered approach/contact/early lift. [600,850) remains 250 actions per demonstration shared with blue_insert and includes goal-centered red descent/release, TCP-relative post-release bridge, and blue-centered transit/contact/lift.
successor_readiness: blue_insert can start at action 600 even while red is held or touching the pad because the shared supervision explicitly performs release before targeting blue. The cleaner nominal switch is near the end of blue_acquire after observed blue/TCP initial-lift co-motion.
failure_signatures: A wrong-phase call creates an action-frame discontinuity or wrong object/gripper intent; red fails to co-move after closure; carried red travels low into furniture; red remains outside the pad or follows after release; TCP crosses before clearing red; transit returns toward red; blue is not under TCP when fingers close; drawer_position falls toward 0.26 m; or IK reports non-convergence/limit contact. None is a demonstrated recovery case.
continuation_guidance: Refresh the phase-selected observed anchor at every sampled chunk and retain real two-frame causal history across policy switches. Advance phase only from object/TCP/gripper relationships: high drawer clearance, red co-motion/elevated lift, red support and release, vertical clearance, then blue approach/co-motion. Prefer h02 when phase confidence is low; use h04 when reliable displaced red, goal, or blue observations make its semantic anchor useful.
limitations: Phase selection is external and must be correct. Anchors are fixed for eight executed slots, and moved or noisy anchors can bias a whole chunk. Displacements may be unreachable or obstructed; bridge_to_blue is not blue-displacement invariant; the demonstrations have fixed red_goal and narrow object ranges. There is no collision planner, contact truth, grasp proof, or demonstrated recovery from a missed grasp, off-pad release, unintended drawer contact, or changed physics.
